description: iPhone Duo prices have been announced, and we compared India prices with prices in the US, Hong Kong, Dubai, Canada, and Europe to see which country is cheapest.
title: Where is the iPhone Duo Cheapest? US, Dubai, Hong Kong, and India Prices Compared

description: Apple has launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max at its 'Surprise and Shine' event on Wednesday. The iPhone 18 duo come with notable hardware upgrades over last year's iPhone 17 Pro models. They run on Apple's latest-generation A20 Pro chipset and include the company's new in-house C2 modem.
title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max Announced: Price in India, Specifications and Features

description: Apple has launched the AirPods 5 with open-ear Active Noise Cancellation and a redesigned acoustic architecture. The company claims the earbuds reduce up to 50 percent more external noise than AirPods 4 with ANC. Apple also claims improved sound quality with next-generation Adaptive EQ. The new AirPods support Siri AI features, head gestures and Live Translation. A second variant comes with a Wireless Charging Case, adding stem-based volume controls and longer battery life, with Apple claiming up to five hours of playback with ANC.
title: Apple Just Gave the Standard AirPods 5 a Massive 'Pro' Upgrade

description: Apple has introduced the latest additions to its smartwatch range with the Watch Series 12 and Watch Ultra 4. The new models bring changes across health monitoring, workout tracking and sensing capabilities through watchOS 27. Apple has also brought back a ceramic case option for the Series 12 and improved battery performance on the Ultra 4. The launch comes alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, as well as Apple’s first foldable iPhone, expanding the company’s latest hardware lineup.
title: Apple Watch Series 12, Watch Ultra 4 Announced With New Health Sensors, S11 Chip: Price in India, Specifications and New Features

description: Apple has launched its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, globally, including India. The foldable was unveiled during the ‘Surprise and Shine’ event on Wednesday. The handset is set to go on sale soon in two distinct colour options, including dark blue and white. The iPhone Duo is equipped with Apple’s A20 Pro chipset, which is built on a 2nm process. It also features a dual 48-megapixel rear camera system, housed inside a pill-shaped camera module.
title: Apple’s First Foldable iPhone Announced: Price in India, Specs and Everything You Need to Know

description: Apple has announced the release date of its latest iOS 27 update for all eligible devices. The company has revealed the list of iPhones that will be getting the latest iOS update. Here’s what you need to know about iOS 27 features, release dates, device compatibility, and more.
title: Apple Announces iOS 27 Release Date: Here’s When It’s Arriving on Your iPhone

description: iPhone 17 price in India has been increased by up to Rs. 17,000, now available at a starting price of Rs. 99,990. The company has updated its website to reflect the new prices. Apart from the iPhone 17, the prices of the iPhone 17e and iPhone Air have also been raised by a significant margin. The tech giant updated its website to reflect the new prices soon after the iPhone 18 Pro series launch event concluded.
title: iPhone 17 Just Got More Expensive in India: See the New Prices

description: Gemini has secured a Major Payment Institution licence from Singapore’s Monetary Authority, allowing its local entity to provide digital payment token and cross-border money transfer services. The approval follows an in-principle licence granted in October 2024. Gemini has operated in Singapore since 2020 and currently offers spot trading, custody, and OTC services.
title: Singapore Grants Gemini Full Licence to Provide Crypto Payment Services

description: The Oppo K14 Lite has reportedly appeared on India's Bureau of Indian Standards database with the model number CPH3007. The listing follows an earlier Google Play Console appearance that linked the model to the K14 Lite name. The upcoming smartphone is expected to be a 4G device and could share its hardware with the Oppo A6c 4G. The A6c launched in India in May with a 120Hz LCD display, Unisoc T7250 chipset, 13-megapixel rear camera and 7,000mAh battery.
title: Oppo K14 Lite Reportedly Appears on BIS Ahead of Expected India Launch

description: Samsung has reportedly begun rolling out the One UI 9 beta for the Galaxy A55. The beta update is available for eligible devices in South Korea and India and requires a download of over 2GB. Samsung Galaxy A55 users who want to test the beta can sign up for the One UI 9 Beta Programme through the Samsung Members app.
title: Samsung Galaxy A55 Gets One UI 9 Beta Update in India With September 2026 Security Patch: Report

description: Germany’s Finance Ministry has reportedly prepared a draft bill to bring cryptocurrency gains under the country’s 25 percent capital income tax from 2028. The proposal would remove the current tax advantage for crypto held for more than a year, while retaining the personal allowance. The ministry expects the changes to generate an additional €350 million in revenue.
title: Germany Considers 25 Percent Tax on Previously Untaxed Crypto Gains

description: Logitech MX Keypad has been launched in India, the tech firm announced on Wednesday. The new keypad will be available for purchase in the country via the Logitech India online store. The Logitech MX Keypad is offered in a single Graphite colour option. The company has yet to announce the exact sale date for its new keypad. Moreover, the company is offering a one-year limited hardware warranty with the new Logitech MX Keypad. Apart from this, customers can get three months of GitHub Copilot Pro+ for free with the device.
title: Logitech MX Keypad Launched in India as a Customisable AI Control Centre With LCD Keys: Price, Features

description: Krafton India is adding a supernatural Bloodline Awakening mode to BGMI with the upcoming 4.6 Update, along with 50 new redeem codes offering in-game rewards. Bloodline Awakening introduces vampires, hunters and new combat mechanics to the battle royale game. Krafton India's new redeem codes are valid until September 25.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes (September 2026): How to Claim Bloodline Awakening Redeem Codes

description: Nothing Phone 2 users have sought further software support after the smartphone was left out of the Nothing OS 5.0 rollout. A Reddit discussion brought responses from CEO Carl Pei and a Nothing employee, while users also requested newer features for the handset. Pei initially misstated the number of Android upgrades the Phone 2 had received before correcting his response. The discussion also highlighted requests for camera improvements and newer interface features, as well as questions about extending chipset support.
title: Nothing Phone 2 to Stop at Android 16 as CEO Carl Pei Explains Update Decision

description: The Oppo Find X10 series is scheduled to make its China debut in September, before expanding to global markets later this year. While details about its India launch officially remain under wraps, a tipster has shared a tentative India launch date and pricing details for the company’s upcoming flagship lineup. The Oppo Find X10 series could make its debut next month, with prices expected to touch the Rs. 1.5 lakh mark.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series Price in India, Launch Date Leaked; May Cost Up to Rs. 1.5 Lakh

description: iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, and iPhone 18 Pro Max designs have been spotted in images of protective cases and skins on dbrand's website. The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are shown to sport the same design as their predecessors, with a flat rear panel featuring a horizontal rectangular camera plateau at the top. There are six cutouts on the camera module, one each for the three camera sensors, one for the LiDAR sensor, one for the LED flash, and one for the secondary microphone. On the other hand, the iPhone Duo appears with a unique design, similar to the ones previously spotted in leaked renders.
title: iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro Series Design and Colour Options Appear in Early Case Listings Online

description: Vivo X500 Pro Max design and colour options have been revealed by a company executive. The Vivo X500 Pro Max is shown to feature a Zeiss-tuned triple rear camera system, with the Zeiss branding placed in the middle. A secondary light sensor will also be placed at the back of the handset. Meanwhile, the LED flashlight appears outside of the camera island, placed in the top-left corner of the dual-tone rear panel. Meanwhile, the vertically aligned Vivo branding will be placed in the bottom-left corner.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Design, Colourways Revealed Alongside the New Extender Kit

description: Oppo Find X10 E will be launched this month as part of the tech firm’s upcoming flagship Find X10 lineup. The phone will be accompanied by the Oppo Find X10, Find X10 Pro, and Find X10 Pro Max. However, the company has yet to confirm the exact launch date. The new Find X10 E is now available for pre-order in China via the company’s online store, along with the Find X10 series, Oppo Watch S2, and Oppo Enco X4 TWS.
title: Oppo Find X10 E Confirmed to Launch Alongside Find X10, Find X10 Pro Max as Pre-Orders Open

description: Apple has acquired Sonera, a company developing chip-based magnetic sensing technology designed for wearable devices, according to a regulatory filing in the European Union (EU). While the Cupertino-based tech giant has not disclosed how it plans to use the technology following the acquisition, it could potentially have implications for Apple's health and accessibility efforts. Sonera had previously said that its approach could enable continuous monitoring of neuromuscular activity, sports performance tracking, and advanced prosthetics control.
title: Apple Acquires Sonera in Deal That Could Bring Brain-Sensing Technology to Future Wearables

description: Bitcoin is holding near $79,000 as traders await US PPI and CPI data ahead of the Federal Reserve’s September meeting. Higher oil prices and renewed Middle East tensions have kept inflation concerns elevated, while ETF inflows and improving market fundamentals continue to provide support. Analysts are watching key support and resistance levels for signs of the next move.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $79,000 as Traders Await US Inflation Data

description: Honor has confirmed the launch date of its upcoming Magic 9 series in China. It is available for pre-order in China ahead of its official debut. The official teasers show the lineup in a green colour option. It is confirmed to come with a 200-megapixel 1/1.28-inch sensor with an f/1.57 aperture and a 200-megapixel 1/1.4-inch telephoto sensor with an f/2.6 aperture.
title: Honor Magic 9 Series Launch Set for September 28; Design, Camera Details Teased

description: Meta has introduced Muse, a personal AI agent that can manage tasks across apps and continue working without constant user input. Available in the US across mobile and web, Muse can handle everything from emails and travel bookings to longer-term goals. It also uses previous conversations to inform future tasks and operates inside Meta’s dedicated Secure VM. Users can control its app permissions, while Sentinel manages internet access. Meta will later add Confidential VM, with support for AI glasses, Shop Pay and 1Password also planned.
title: Meta Muse Launched as Personal AI Agent With WhatsApp Support

description: The Financial Intelligence Unit-India has issued compliance notices to 15 Virtual Digital Asset Service Providers under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act. The action covers offshore and onshore VDA businesses operating in India and follows requirements for registration, reporting, and record-keeping under the country’s anti-money laundering framework.
title: FIU-IND Issues Notices to 15 VDA Service Providers for PMLA Non-Compliance in India

description: Flipkart has launched a standalone app for its quick-commerce service, Flipkart Minutes, in India. The app promises to deliver groceries, daily essentials, electronics, and other products within 10 minutes. The app currently only shows up on the Google Play Store for Android devices. The move comes amidst the online shopping giant’s continued push into the quick commerce market, with the company recently expanding to more than 1,000 dark stores across 120-130 cities.
title: Flipkart Takes on Blinkit and Zepto With New Dedicated Minutes App in India

description: iQOO’s unannounced tablet, the Pad Ultra, was recently revealed to be a mini tablet with compact dimensions. Another unique detail in these leaks was a vent and a built-in cooling fan. A new teaser by the brand has now revealed the design and specifications of this cooling fan, along with a glimpse of a controller accessory.
title: iQOO Pad Ultra Teased as Gaming-Focused Mini Tablet With Built-In Cooling Fan

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra may stick with its existing biometric options instead of adopting Metalenz's Polar ID system. A tipster claims there is currently no sign of Samsung preparing the technology for its next flagship or other Galaxy phones. Earlier reports linked the rumour to experimental testing by Samsung's System LSI division. The company is expected to retain an ultrasonic fingerprint scanner and camera-based face unlock. Samsung is also reportedly exploring camera hardware changes to manage production costs without increasing the phone's price.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Tipped to Skip Polar ID Face Unlock Technology

description: OpenAI has released ChatGPT Images 2.5. It claims ChatGPT Images 2.5 produces more natural lighting and richer textures. It is said to deliver up to 50 percent reduced image generation latency compared to Images 2.0. It has also added features like Sketch, templates, and comments. OpenAI has also released two versions of Images 2.5 for developers to build around in their apps.
title: OpenAI Launches Images 2.5 With Features Like Sketch, Comments, and More

description: Apple will reportedly launch the Apple TV 4K set-top box and HomePod Mini 2 alongside the iPhone 18 Pro series during the Surprise and Shine event or shortly after. By the end of 2026, the company is expected to unveil its first iPad Mini model with an OLED display, which is said to be “one of the biggest updates” in the product’s history. Apart from this, Apple will reportedly refresh the iMac and the 14-inch MacBook Pro model with its latest M6 chipset. The company is also expected to unveil the first MacBook model with a touchscreen, which will reportedly be marketed as MacBook Ultra.
title: Apple Product Roadmap Through 2029: iPhones, Macs, Smart Glasses and More Tipped

description: Nintendo has fully revealed The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. The game will launch exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5, weeks before the release of GTA 6. The remake features a new art style and enhanced visuals, fully voiced cutscenes, expanded character dialogue, symphonic orchestral music, reworked camera and movement controls, and more.
title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Fully Revealed, Release Date Set for November

description: Despite the growing popularity of smart rings in recent years, Garmin has so far stayed away from the category. A recent report suggests that this could change soon, as a series of new regulatory filings suggest that the wearables company may be planning a foray into the smart ring category. The smart ring is reported to come with the Cirqa moniker and may be offered in multiple sizes, with 10 related Garmin model variants listed on the certification site.
title: Garmin Cirqa Smart Ring Reportedly Gets Regulatory Approval With 10 Size Options; Price, Launch Date Leaked

description: OpenAI announced a solution to the three-dimensional Navier–Stokes problem on Tuesday. The ChatGPT maker used an internal OpenAI system to show that the dynamics of the Navier-Stokes equations for fluid motion can develop a singularity in finite time. The result, however, raised questions about unpublished work of mathematicians. OpenAI asserts that its researchers and AI agents did not access Alpöge and Buckmaster's work before its public release.
title: OpenAI Says Its AI Has Solved the 90-Year-Old Navier–Stokes Problem

description: The UK government is moving towards legislation that could require Apple and Google to introduce stronger controls for children using smartphones and tablets. The proposed rules would address the creation, viewing and sharing of nude images, with the government considering protections that work across operating systems and individual apps. The move follows a voluntary three-month period for the companies to strengthen their existing safeguards. The UK is still deciding which devices the law would cover, while adults passing age verification would remain exempt.
title: Apple, Google Could Be Forced to Block Explicit Images on Children’s Smartphones Under New UK Law

description: After announcing plans for a two-week release cycle for Google Chrome, the company has finally kickstarted it with the release of Chrome 153. Chrome 153 brings the usual security updates and patches, but Google claims the two-week release cycle will enable it to deliver security fixes faster, leading to a safer web-browsing experience.
title: Google’s Chrome 153 Starts Two-Week Release Cycle Promising Faster Updates and Secure Browsing

description: Motorola's Signature series made its debut earlier this year with a focus on a slim design, high-end hardware, and a distinctive aesthetic. Now, the company appears to be preparing its successor. According to a report, a teaser for a handset called the “Signature 27” briefly appeared on Motorola's website, showing a close-up of the rear camera module. The teaser has since disappeared, but its appearance across multiple websites reportedly offers clues about Motorola's next premium smartphone.
title: Motorola Signature 27 Reportedly Teased Ahead of Possible Launch, Swarovski Edition Also Tipped

description: Oppo has launched the A7 Pro in China in three colour options. It has a 6.57-inch display with a refresh rate of up to 120Hz. It is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 6360 Max chipset, paired with up to 8GB of RAM. Oppo A7 Pro has an 8,000mAh battery that supports 45W SuperVOOC Flash Charge. It has a 50-megapixel rear camera.
title: Oppo A7 Pro Launched With 8,000mAh Battery, MediaTek Dimensity 6360 Max SoC: Price, Specifications

description: Sony has expanded its wireless headphone range with the WH-1000XM4C, WH-CH730N and WH-CH530, covering premium, mid-range and entry-level segments. The WH-1000XM4C gets refreshed sound tuning and a 10-band equaliser, while the WH-CH730N combines ANC with improved call quality and a foldable design. The WH-CH530 offers up to 55 hours of playback and AI-powered noise reduction for calls. Prices start at GBP 49.99 (roughly Rs. 6,400), with all three models set to go on sale in the UK later this week.
title: Sony WH-1000XM4C Launched Alongside WH-CH730N, WH-CH530 Headphones With Up to 55 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Apple’s ‘Surprise and shine’ event is finally set to take place today. The hardware showcase has been rumoured to mark a significant change in the iPhone lineup. The company is expected to introduce its first foldable iPhone alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, new Apple Watch models and AirPods. The foldable, reportedly called the iPhone Duo, is expected to feature a book-style design, with prices starting at around $2,000. The event will also reportedly bring new health and fitness features to the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, alongside updates to Apple's AirPods lineup.
title: Apple Event Last-Minute Leaks: iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro Models, Watch Series 12 to Reportedly Debut Today

description: Apple will be bringing Pusheen’s Place as an Apple Arcade exclusive from October 1. The game will be available exclusively on Apple Arcade. Apple will also bring another title, River City Survivors: Downtown of the Dead, to the platform, along with some other additions from the App Store.
title: Apple Arcade to Add Pusheen’s First Game, River City Survivors and More on October 1

description: Apple is expected to launch its first foldable iPhone model tonight during the Surprise and Shine event. According to a report, Apple’s first foldable iPhone could cost well over $2,000 (roughly Rs. 1,90,000). The tech giant was reportedly targeting $1,999 (about Rs. 1,90,000), aiming not to breach the “controversial barrier” of $2,000. The company was planning to follow a similar strategy to what it did in 2017 by pricing the iPhone X at $999 (roughly Rs. 95,000). However, that does not seem to be the case anymore.
title: Apple’s Foldable iPhone to Launch With a Price Tag of Over $2,000 After Being in Development for a Decade: Report

description: Apple will host its ‘Surprise and Shine’ event today at Apple Park in Cupertino, California. The showcase will begin at 10 am PT. However, if you are in India, you will be able to catch the livestream at 10:30 pm IST. Apple has scheduled the livestream via multiple social media platforms and video streaming services. Apart from this, you will also be able to watch the livestream of the iPhone launch event via Apple’s official YouTube channel and the Apple TV app. Based on numerous reports and leaks, Apple is widely expected to launch the foldable iPhone, iPhone 18 Pro series, AirPods 5, and Watch Series 12.
title: Apple ‘Surprise and Shine’ Event Today: How to Watch Foldable iPhone, iPhone 18 Pro Series Launch Live

description: Apple Surprise and Shine event will begin tonight at 10:30 pm IST. The event will be livestreamed via Apple's official YouTube channel. Today's launch event could mark Apple's entry into a completely new product category. The tech giant is expected to launch its very first book-style foldable smartphone, which could either be called the iPhone Ultra or iPhone Duo. Rumours suggest that the foldable will be equipped with Samsung's new display technology, minimising the visible crease on the inner foldable screen.
title: LIVE Apple 'Surprise and Shine' Event: First Foldable iPhone, iPhone 18 Pro Series and More Expected to Debut
